title: Bby Wow pets
notes: Source template, not stored in this repo: 6.042s vertical 720x1280 nightclub dance. Hypit media probe confirmed duration and 24fps. hypit media boundaries --rate 8 --threshold 0.1 returned a single weak candidate at 4.5s (score 0.105); that is a head-toss inside a continuous locked shot, not a hard cut, so it was not used as a generation split. The source is inside the 4-12s range and stays one generation segment. Story beats follow the integer-second dance phrases 0-2s, 2-4s, and 4-6s. Role slots are the customer remake, not a human dancer.

storyBeats.summary: Packed nightclub, saturated purple and magenta lights, soft haze, a blurred crowd behind. The pet faces the camera in a black ribbed camisole and black shorts, already swaying, fur in motion. Locked medium close-up slightly below eye level.
The same locked medium close-up holds. The pet lifts both paws, raises its chin, and keeps grooving as the fur settles then moves again. The club lights and crowd stay behind.
The same locked shot holds. The pet tosses its head so fur flies across the frame (the 4.5s Hypit motion peak), then tilts, smiles slightly, and keeps dancing to the end.
